rules: APPROVED authorizes no artifact mutation and no remaining blocker; any populated correction fields are inactive and discarded by the deterministic runtime.
REVISED returns only focused corrections that differ from current values, fully correct the reviewed Story version, and leave no remaining blocker.
NOT_APPROVED identifies the exact unresolved defect and returns no speculative correction.
Every correction is deterministically revalidated before the next SAQC review begins.
If any Story version is corrected, the complete next SAQC iteration restarts from Story Segment Core.
Only a complete iteration with no corrections produces NO_CORRECTIONS_NEEDED and permits final Quality Control completion.
If the maximum iteration count is reached while corrections are still required, stop with NOT_APPROVED instead of starting an unbounded local-model loop.
No workflow file may be edited during SAQC.

required_content: Story identifier, numeric iteration and persistent numeric report identifier
Exact structured Lumimaid result for SSC, Full and Prompt-Realized
SHA-256 values for all four Story artifacts before and after the iteration
Every correction applied and any remaining blocker
rules: Write exactly one report for every started SAQC iteration, including an iteration that ends with NOT_APPROVED.
Allocate a new monotonically increasing report ID per Story and never overwrite or delete an earlier report.
Preserve the model-returned review data without a separate LLM summarization call.
Write reports atomically and never modify ComfyUI workflow files.
Write exactly five VSSAQC files for every started SAQC iteration.
Do not start an additional model call for a VSSAQC file.
Premise VSSAQC records only the approved premise snapshot state.
Prompt-Realized JSON and Markdown VSSAQC files are split deterministically from the same Prompt-Realized SAQC result.
